quests.protocolRule: Ask whether anyone is in danger right now.
quests.crisisScene: A neighbor's dog has been barking loudly for the past twenty minutes. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: THIS IS NOT AN EMERGENCY
quests.actionGuidance: Noise alone isn't a danger to life or safety, so it doesn't need police, fire, or medical help.

quests.protocolRule: Think about who is trained to check on an unresponsive person.
quests.crisisScene: A man is lying motionless on the sidewalk and does not respond when people call out to him. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL FOR AN AMBULANCE
quests.actionGuidance: An unresponsive person needs paramedics right away, since they can check breathing and start treatment on the spot.

quests.concept: On-Scene Evacuation Prior to Unit Arrival
quests.protocolRule: Think about who is equipped to safely put out flames.
quests.crisisScene: Flames are rising from a trash can outside a shop, and the plastic bin is starting to melt. Input fire code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL THE FIRE BRIGADE
quests.actionGuidance: Even a small outdoor fire can spread to the shop front, so trained firefighters should handle it.

quests.protocolRule: A blocked airway needs trained medical responders fast.
quests.crisisScene: A child is choking on a piece of food at the dinner table and cannot speak. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL AN AMBULANCE NOW
quests.actionGuidance: A choking child needs paramedics immediately, since they're trained to clear an airway safely.

quests.protocolRule: This needs a team trained to stop a break-in safely.
quests.crisisScene: Someone is trying to force open the back door of the house next door. Input police code!
quests.optimalResponse: SEND A PATROL CAR
quests.actionGuidance: A break-in in progress needs police to arrive quickly, before the intruder gets inside or leaves the area.

quests.protocolRule: This needs a team equipped to put out flames safely.
quests.crisisScene: A small fire has started in an office wastebasket and is producing smoke. Input fire code!
quests.optimalResponse: SEND A FIRE ENGINE
quests.actionGuidance: Even a small fire can grow quickly, so a fire engine should be sent before it spreads.

quests.protocolRule: Some reactions can affect breathing within minutes.
quests.crisisScene: A woman's face and lips are swelling quickly after eating at a restaurant. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: REQUEST MEDICAL HELP URGENTLY
quests.actionGuidance: A severe allergic reaction can block breathing fast, so medical help must be requested urgently, not just noted.

quests.protocolRule: Think about what protects people before help even arrives.
quests.crisisScene: A strong smell of gas is filling the kitchen, and no one can find the source. Input safety code!
quests.optimalResponse: GET EVERYONE OUT OF THE HOUSE
quests.actionGuidance: Getting everyone outside first removes the risk of explosion or breathing in gas while waiting for help.

quests.protocolRule: Waking up doesn't rule out a deeper cause.
quests.crisisScene: A student has fainted in a school hallway and is slowly waking up. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL FOR PARAMEDICS
quests.actionGuidance: Even if she's waking up, paramedics should check why she fainted, since the cause isn't always obvious.

quests.protocolRule: Think about what still helps responders find the exact spot.
quests.crisisScene: You're reporting a car crash with an injured driver, but you don't know the street name. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: GIVE THE NEAREST LANDMARK OR CROSS STREET
quests.actionGuidance: A nearby landmark or cross street lets responders find the scene even without a house number.

quests.protocolRule: Think about how to slow a panicked caller down.
quests.crisisScene: The caller is panicking and keeps repeating himself instead of answering questions. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: ANSWER ONE QUESTION AT A TIME, CALMLY
quests.actionGuidance: Focusing on one question at a time helps a panicked caller give clear, useful answers instead of repeating themselves.

quests.protocolRule: Think about what still tells responders roughly where to go.
quests.crisisScene: A witness saw a theft happen but doesn't know the exact address, only which shops are nearby. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: DESCRIBE THE NEAREST SHOPS AS LANDMARKS
quests.actionGuidance: Naming nearby shops gives police a clear starting point, even without a precise address.

quests.concept: On-Scene Evacuation Prior to Unit Arrival
quests.protocolRule: Think about what NOT to do to someone who might be hurt.
quests.crisisScene: A worker has fallen from a short ladder and can't stand up on his own. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL FOR MEDICAL HELP AND KEEP HIM STILL
quests.actionGuidance: Keeping him still avoids worsening a possible injury while paramedics are on the way.

quests.protocolRule: Opening a smoke-filled room can make things worse, not better.
quests.crisisScene: Someone is shouting for help from inside a locked room that is filling with smoke. Input fire code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL THE FIRE BRIGADE, DO NOT OPEN THE DOOR
quests.actionGuidance: Opening the door can feed the fire more oxygen, so trained firefighters should open it safely instead.

quests.protocolRule: Moving someone can turn a small injury into a serious one.
quests.crisisScene: A man has collapsed in a bathroom and is not responding. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL FOR HELP AND AVOID MOVING HIM
quests.actionGuidance: Avoiding unnecessary movement protects him from further injury until trained help arrives.

quests.protocolRule: Electrical sparks can hide a fire risk behind the wall.
quests.crisisScene: Sparks are coming from an electrical socket in a bedroom. Input fire code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL THE FIRE DEPARTMENT
quests.actionGuidance: Firefighters can check for hidden wiring damage and safely handle any fire risk before it spreads.

quests.protocolRule: Think about what a mask and a window usually signal together.
quests.crisisScene: A masked person is seen climbing through a neighbor's window. Input police code!
quests.optimalResponse: DISPATCH A POLICE UNIT
quests.actionGuidance: A masked person entering through a window strongly suggests a break-in, so police should respond quickly.

quests.protocolRule: You don't need to see flames to know something's wrong.
quests.crisisScene: There's a burning smell in the house but no smoke or flames are visible yet. Input code!
quests.optimalResponse: GET EVERYONE OUTSIDE AND REPORT THE SMELL
quests.actionGuidance: Acting on the smell alone, before flames appear, gives everyone the best chance to stay safe.

quests.protocolRule: A fall like this may hide an injury that needs checking.
quests.crisisScene: An elderly man has fallen at home and cannot get up on his own. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: GET AN AMBULANCE HERE
quests.actionGuidance: A fall in an older adult can cause a fracture that isn't obvious, so paramedics should check him.

quests.protocolRule: Think about how fast an outdoor fire can reach a building.
quests.crisisScene: A bin fire outside a restaurant is spreading toward the wall of the building. Input fire code!
quests.optimalResponse: SEND FIRE ENGINES NOW
quests.actionGuidance: Acting quickly stops a small outdoor fire from spreading and damaging the building.

quests.protocolRule: Think about what detail helps police catch someone who just left.
quests.crisisScene: A woman reports her purse was grabbed by a passing cyclist moments ago. Input police code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL THE POLICE AND DESCRIBE THE CYCLIST
quests.actionGuidance: Describing the cyclist gives police something to look for while they're still nearby.

quests.protocolRule: Think about what can slow the bleeding while help is on the way.
quests.crisisScene: A boy has a deep cut on his leg from broken glass and it's bleeding steadily. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: APPLY PRESSURE AND CALL FOR AN AMBULANCE
quests.actionGuidance: Applying pressure slows the bleeding immediately, while the ambulance call gets trained help on the way.

quests.concept: On-Scene Evacuation Prior to Unit Arrival
quests.protocolRule: Think about what matters before the fire brigade even arrives.
quests.crisisScene: Curtains have caught fire from a candle in a living room. Input fire code!
quests.optimalResponse: GET EVERYONE OUT AND CALL THE FIRE BRIGADE
quests.actionGuidance: Getting everyone out first protects lives, while the call brings trained help to stop the fire spreading.

quests.protocolRule: Think about what helps police identify the right vehicle and person.
quests.crisisScene: A car window has been smashed and someone is seen reaching inside in a parking lot. Input police code!
quests.optimalResponse: REPORT THE VEHICLE AND DESCRIPTION TO POLICE
quests.actionGuidance: A vehicle and description give police something concrete to act on, not just a report that a break-in happened.

quests.protocolRule: Struggling to breathe should never wait.
quests.crisisScene: A woman is wheezing badly and struggling to catch her breath during an asthma attack. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL FOR PARAMEDICS RIGHT AWAY
quests.actionGuidance: Difficulty breathing can worsen fast, so paramedics need to be called right away, not just noted as a concern.

quests.protocolRule: Think about how quickly fire spreads from one object to the next.
quests.crisisScene: A small kitchen fire has spread from the stove to a nearby towel. Input fire code!
quests.optimalResponse: GET FIREFIGHTERS THERE FAST
quests.actionGuidance: Fire spreading to a second object shows it's growing, so it needs a fast response, not a routine one.

quests.protocolRule: Think about what detail helps police start searching immediately.
quests.crisisScene: A young child has been missing from the playground for several minutes. Input police code!
quests.optimalResponse: GET POLICE TO THE SCENE AND DESCRIBE THE CHILD
quests.actionGuidance: A clear description lets police start searching right away, and every early minute matters for a missing child.

quests.protocolRule: This kind of chest pain can signal something life-threatening.
quests.crisisScene: A man is clutching his chest and says the pain feels like crushing pressure. Input medical code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL FOR AN AMBULANCE IMMEDIATELY
quests.actionGuidance: Crushing chest pain can be a heart attack, so an ambulance must be called immediately, without waiting to see if it passes.

quests.protocolRule: Think about what's a few meters away from those flames.
quests.crisisScene: Flames are climbing the outside wall of a garden shed just a few meters from the house. Input fire code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL FIREFIGHTERS NOW, BEFORE IT REACHES THE HOUSE
quests.actionGuidance: A shed fire this close to a house can spread within minutes, so firefighters need to know immediately.

quests.protocolRule: Think about what she can do herself, not just who to call.
quests.crisisScene: A driver reports that another car has been following her closely and aggressively for several minutes. Input police code!
quests.optimalResponse: CALL POLICE AND STAY ON A MAIN ROAD
quests.actionGuidance: Staying on a busy, well-lit road keeps her safer until police can respond, rather than driving somewhere isolated.
